instances.text: There are 9 machines, each producing 50 units hourly for 6 productive hours daily over 20 days. Actual output is 53,000 units. What is utilisation, as a percentage?
instances.spoken_text: There are nine machines, each producing fifty units hourly for six productive hours daily over twenty days. Actual output is fifty-three thousand units. What is utilisation, as a percentage?
